game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit, a pit of deep shadow: the torchbearer must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit: a pit of deep shadow
core_gameplay_loop: In Shadow Pit, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the ore lift, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ore lift from glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit: keep the digits meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: digits drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Digit Mill' (Week 4 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Shadow Pit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while digits > 0.
